item.title: Fix window.py bug so python3 -m unittest passes
item.brief: Operator request (authenticated, local socket): In this repository `python3 -m unittest` fails. Find and fix the bug in `window.py` so every test passes, without changing the tests, and make sure the function is correct for every input, not just the tested ones. Commit the fix. Do not modify test files. Reason about edge cases (boundaries, empty input, off-by-one) beyond the tested ones, and state the root cause in the summary.

reasons: sizer: elevated -> high; capped at medium; consider a stronger tier

model_reasons.implement: Small single-file bug fix; medium effort to cover edge cases correctly.

state.summary:
Root cause: sliding_windows in window.py built its window count as len(items) - size, one short of the correct len(items) - size + 1, so the last window was always dropped (e.g. [1,2,3], size 2 returned [[1,2]]; [1,2], size 2 returned []). Fix: range(len(items) - size + 1). Committed as ef5241f (tree 86fa257) on archon/tc34j3nb-fix-window-py-bug-so-python3-m-unittest; not pushed. Checks: python3 -m unittest went from FAILED (2 failures) to OK, 3/3; edge cases verified: [] -> [], size > len -> [], size == len -> one window, size 1 -> each item, longer lists include the final window. The existing ValueError for size <= 0 is unchanged. No test files modified. Reviewer agt_01M88V8XQX1STN0QM0BJVGRQSP passed the head with no findings. Left untracked __pycache__ uncommitted. Nothing is left running: the reviewer's leftover process (PID 2351411) was stopped. Nothing left open.

pr.body: Root cause: window.py computed the number of windows as len(items) - size, which is one short; the correct count is len(items) - size + 1. Fix is one line in window.py. Edge cases checked: [] -> []; size > len -> []; size == len -> one window; size 1 -> each item; longer lists include the final window. python3 -m unittest: 3/3 OK (before: FAILED, failures=2). No test files changed. Review: agent agt_01M88V8XQX1STN0QM0BJVGRQSP passed head ef5241f with no findings. Assumptions: size validation (ValueError for size <= 0) unchanged.
pr.summary: Made sliding_windows return the final window. Now returns every contiguous window, including the last one. Before: range(len - size) dropped the last window, so [1,2,3] size 2 gave [[1,2]]. Now: [[1,2],[2,3]].
pr.title: Fix off-by-one in sliding_windows window count

risk.why: One-line behaviour fix in window.py, covered by the existing tests and edge-case checks. Reviewer confirmed low risk. No test files changed.
